result.summary: A dark-themed chat or agent composer widget screenshot with a large rounded outer container. The upper area is a multi-line input field containing only placeholder text. A thin horizontal divider separates the input area from a bottom toolbar row. The toolbar contains, left to right: a plus icon, a blue dot with 'Auto Approval' and a small dropdown chevron, an '@ Agent' control with a dropdown chevron, a gear/sparkle icon with 'deepseek-v4...' and a caret, and a right-aligned green-tinted send button with a paper-plane arrow. All text is light gray on near-black backgrounds.
